name: jsii-target-ruby
description: Ruby language target for jsii, as an external jsii-pacmak plugin. Generates idiomatic Ruby bindings (snake_case members, keyword-argument props, lazy autoloads, RBS signatures) from any jsii assembly.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:compliance
scripts.test:compliance: bash compliance/generate.sh && cd compliance && bundle install --quiet && bundle exec rspec --require ./spec/compliance_formatter.rb --format ComplianceFormatter --format progress

//: SPIKE NOTE: dependency ranges are placeholders and node_modules is symlinked into the sibling jsii monorepo checkout; the real package pins the published jsii-pacmak plugin API.
